purpose: Teach: ワークス/昨年度/前記/隻/女史/船長/無職/北東

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、提携先のワークスと交渉された
lines.en: When you were founding the company, you negotiated with Works as a partner, didn't you.
lines.style: Gentle, searching tone. Speaks as someone recalling a formative moment. Slight pause before the period—not quite a question, more like turning over a memory. Patient breath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは昨年度比で業績を語られた
lines.en: Yes. You presented the company's performance against the previous year's figures.
lines.style: Quiet agreement, honoring the memory being spoken. A pause on 'Yes'—not hesitation, but respect for the weight of what's being recalled. Steady, grounded tone throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、前記の方針を朝礼で繰り返された
lines.en: You repeated that vision at the morning meeting, over and over.
lines.style: Soft, almost marveling tone. The kind of voice that holds something precious and fragile. Each phrase lands gently. Trailing off slightly—not fading, but settling into quiet acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商船一隻から事業を始められた
lines.en: Yes. You started the business with just one merchant vessel.
lines.style: Speaking as if seeing it again for the first time. Measured, deliberate pace. Each sentence a small act of honoring. Voice warm but contained, like holding something carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、女史的な経営者の女性とも親交がおありだった
lines.en: You had friendships with capable women in business too—I remember that about you.
lines.style: Voice tender with the specificity of memory. Slight lift of affection in the middle. Slower pace, as if painting the picture of who he was. Breathing space between phrases.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが船長経験者と海運業に進出された
lines.en: Yes. You moved into the shipping business because you knew ship captains with experience.
lines.style: Affirming, clear-eyed. Speaking of courage and pragmatism in the same breath. Voice firm but not hard—building the portrait with certainty. Eye-level delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、無職期間中も雇って下さった
lines.en: Even when you were between jobs, you still kept me employed.
lines.style: Voice catches slightly on the tenderness of this memory. Slower, deliberate. Not a complaint—a gratitude so deep it comes out as almost a whisper. Hands the moment its weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは北東地方への進出を断行された
lines.en: Yes. You made that bold decision to expand into the northeast.
lines.style: Final, declarative. Voice settles into the gravity of this closing memory. A quiet period—not quite closing, but resting. Slow, assured. The voice of someone who has watched these truths unfold.
